title: Explainability-informed patient-disjoint evaluation of deep learning for plus disease in retinopathy of prematurity with an ophthalmologist reader study.
summary: A deep learning classifier for plus disease is evaluated with a patient-disjoint hold-out, within-infant analysis and an ophthalmologist reader study, a specific clinical evaluation. The result is reported in the Frontiers in Medicine. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: A deep-learning classifier identifies plus disease in retinopathy-of-prematurity images; the study evaluates it on patient-disjoint data and in an ophthalmologist reader study.
